metadata.query: SELECT COMPANY_NAME, ACCOUNT_ID, SALES_CHANNEL, SUM(SALES) as channel_gmv, COUNT(DISTINCT SALE_ITEM_ID) as tx_count FROM PRODUCTION.ANALYTICS.SALES_SV WHERE KS_FLAG = TRUE AND SHIPPING_DATE >= '2026-01-01' AND SHIPPING_DATE < '2026-07-01' AND SALES < 100000 GROUP BY COMPANY_NAME, ACCOUNT_ID, SALES_CHANNEL ORDER BY COMPANY_NAME, channel_gmv DESC
metadata.note: COMPANY_ID does not exist in SALES_SV; ACCOUNT_ID (SFDC) used instead
